Description.Name: Mychel
Description.Details: Nearly relegated to the Technician Caste, MechWarrior Mychel was able to down her opponent in her Trial of Position only seconds before her 'Mech was incapacitated. Similar circumstances led to her capture and indenture as a bondswoman. Her skills at field repairs earned her the callsign "Wrench" from the other mercenaries.
